name: Diósjenő (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Diósjenő (a crowned blue shield with a walnut tree, with a helm and blue and grey mantling) above the name DIÓSJENŐ in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Diósjenő arms with crown, helm and mantling
